topics.label: Course introduction and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It welcomes the students, introduces the lecture series structure, and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: They define cancer as a disruption of normal developmental differentiation and three-dimensional tissue organization driven by accumulated genetic alterations, and discuss the experimental approaches used to study tumor cells.

topics.label: Mechanisms and histological stages of tumor invasion and progression
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how neoplasms progress from localized benign growths to invasive and metastatic malignancies, illustrating the histological features, routes of spread, and variable clinical behavior of tumor development.

topics.label: Neoplasm nomenclature and classification conventions
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the standardized naming conventions and notable exceptions used to classify benign and malignant tumors based on their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Pathological mechanisms of cancer-induced illness and death
topics.groupedBecause: It details the physiological and anatomical mechanisms through which local and metastatic tumors produce symptoms, systemic complications, and mortality.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: They compare the incidence, mortality, and anatomical distributions of various tumor types across human populations and diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Principles and clinical practice of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: They explore the clinical rationale, diagnostic methods, and varying effectiveness of population screening programs across cervical, colorectal, breast, and prostate cancers.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and review of learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It summarizes the session, directs students to review the learning outcomes, and concludes the lecture with logistical reminders.
